## History

Ludovic Speed resides in Middle Grafton and has spent a long time courting [Theodora Dix](../character/theodora-dix.md), with Mrs. Rachel noting that his courtship has lasted for a hundred years.

## Relationships

### [Theodora Dix](../character/theodora-dix.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ludovic-speed--theodora-dix.md)

Ludovic Speed has been courting [Theodora Dix](../character/theodora-dix.md) for a very long time by the third volume of the story. Their prolonged, ongoing elderly romance is well-known in the local area around [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road). Despite the extended duration of his courtship, the two remain romantically involved.

- Romantically involved with — courting her for a long time  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P19](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0019), [v3 ch.People P19](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0019), +1 more</sub>
